summary_en: Shionogi raised its full-year dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 by 15 yen to 86 yen per share, comprising an interim dividend of 40 yen (up 2 yen from prior forecast, up 7 yen year-on-year) and a year-end dividend of 46 yen (up 8 yen from prior forecast), following better-than-expected earnings driven by growth investments.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Annual Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Shionogi & Co., Ltd. raised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend was increased by 2 yen from the prior forecast to 40 yen per share (up 7 yen year-on-year), and the year-end dividend was increased by 8 yen from the prior forecast to 46 yen per share, resulting in a full-year dividend of 86 yen, up 15 yen from the prior year.

The dividend increase follows an upward revision of full-year earnings forecasts. The company reported that during the first half of fiscal year 2027, actual results exceeded forecast across all revenue and profit metrics. The earnings improvement reflects positive results from growth investments executed in fiscal 2025, particularly in overseas operations where the RADICAVA business transition proceeded smoothly and HIV-related operations at Viiv showed strong performance with increased royalty and equity method income. Domestically, insomnia treatment drug Coobivic, Torii-related products, and ALS treatment drug Radicatt performed well.

Management also upgraded full-year revenue to 720.0 billion yen (from 700.0 billion), operating profit to 230.0 billion yen (from 220.0 billion), and net income attributable to parent to 212.5 billion yen (from 210.0 billion), reflecting strong execution across existing and newly invested business areas.
